functions.name: workflow_runs
functions.description: Visible workflow run identities. Reruns update the same run; status, conclusion and run_started_at describe the latest attempt. Actor and triggering actor are distinct roles, not commit authors. Typed referenced workflows retain their own path/ref/SHA; matching_pull_requests are open PRs sharing the head and do not establish trigger causality. Git commit author/committer remain separate from actor and triggering_actor. Repository snapshots describe base/head contexts; API action URLs are metadata and are never followed as commands.

metrics.name: workflow_run_count
metrics.comment: Visible workflow run identities. Reruns update the same run; status, conclusion and run_started_at describe the latest attempt. Actor and triggering actor are distinct roles, not commit authors.

metrics.name: workflow_run_success_count
metrics.comment: Visible workflow run identities. Reruns update the same run; status, conclusion and run_started_at describe the latest attempt. Actor and triggering actor are distinct roles, not commit authors. Counts records whose conclusion equals success; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

metrics.name: workflow_run_failure_count
metrics.comment: Visible workflow run identities. Reruns update the same run; status, conclusion and run_started_at describe the latest attempt. Actor and triggering actor are distinct roles, not commit authors. Counts records whose conclusion equals failure; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

metrics.name: workflow_run_cancelled_count
metrics.comment: Visible workflow run identities. Reruns update the same run; status, conclusion and run_started_at describe the latest attempt. Actor and triggering actor are distinct roles, not commit authors. Counts records whose conclusion equals cancelled; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

functions.name: workflow_artifacts
functions.description: Visible Actions artifact metadata, distinct from release assets. Expired artifacts remain if returned; deleted artifacts are absent. Artifact names are not identities and run linkage may be NULL. Repository selection includes artifacts without discoverable runs; workflow and run selections follow their listing endpoints. No attempt-specific artifact population is claimed. Analytical enrichment follows the known repository directly, preserving artifacts with no discoverable run. Run identity and bidirectional run retrieval remain explicit, but artifact aggregation by attributes from the run or workflow entities is not approved because it would introduce a competing analytical path and can lose orphan artifacts. Nullable workflow_run metadata includes its actual repository/head-repository IDs, without assigning a missing run or fork to the requested repository by assumption.

metrics.name: workflow_artifact_count
metrics.comment: Visible Actions artifact metadata, distinct from release assets. Expired artifacts remain if returned; deleted artifacts are absent. Artifact names are not identities and run linkage may be NULL. Repository selection includes artifacts without discoverable runs; workflow and run selections follow their listing endpoints. No attempt-specific artifact population is claimed. Analytical enrichment follows the known repository directly, preserving artifacts with no discoverable run. Run identity and bidirectional run retrieval remain explicit, but artifact aggregation by attributes from the run or workflow entities is not approved because it would introduce a competing analytical path and can lose orphan artifacts.

workflow_artifact_bytes.comment: Sum of reported bytes for selected visible artifacts, including expired artifacts if returned; not retained storage usage or billing.
